name: Starcoin
rootCause: On February 18th, Starcoin, a project within the Move ecosystem, tweeted that they detected abnormal activities on their network that required immediate attention to safeguard the integrity and security of the system. As a precautionary measure, Starcoin has temporarily suspended our network to conduct a thorough investigation together with SlowMist.
